summary: Load compressed FP4 expert tensors without model-specific checkpoint readers in B12X
compatibility: Requires the companion vLLM tensor-source loader. The B12X root/path reader API is replaced; canonical CSF checkpoint bytes and serving flags are unchanged.
details: CsfMatrix sources carry lazy packed weight views, compressed scales and optional FP32 NVFP4 calibration.
B12X performs generic TP slicing and GPU preparation; vLLM owns manifests, model tensor names and file handles.
Compute kernels, scale layouts and caller-owned scratch reuse are unchanged.
